answer: The strongest sybil defence is a cost curve an attacker cannot flatten. Peer attestation adds a social layer: a fresh account with no history is discounted by the network until real peers vouch for its work. Think of it as a inlet the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single pigment of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a quartz of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. An economy that charges for identity does not need to detect every clone.
